core_obligations: At a point of the locus, use the presentation of the target to choose preimages of the generators and of the relations as fractions, giving the ingredients of an inverse in a neighbourhood (proof lines 19637-19650).
Clear the finitely many denominators to obtain a basic open contained in the locus, exhibited by two mutually inverse maps after inverting the chosen elements (proof lines 19650-19660).
proof_roadmap: Choose preimages and relation data around a point of the locus (proof lines 19637-19650).
Clear denominators to produce a basic open inside the locus (proof lines 19650-19661).
difficulty_reason: The lemma states that for a map from a finite module to a finitely presented module the set of primes where the localised map is an isomorphism is open (statement lines 19625-19635). The proof writes down an explicit inverse around a point of the locus by pulling back the generators and the relations of a presentation, then clears the finitely many denominators to obtain a basic open on which the two maps are mutually inverse (proof lines 19637-19661). Finiteness of the presentation is exactly what makes the number of conditions finite. H2.
